goal: Deliver a safe, deterministic ecosystem showcase library with a versioned top-level CLI, compatibility-preserving JavaScript and WordPress adapters, a capability-based Laravel profile and matrix system, recoverable multi-app recipes, and documented offline and opt-in golden-path verification.

tasks.title: Top-level showcase contract and orchestrator
acceptance: Create scripts/showcase/showcase.sh with adapter protocol v1 and deterministic list, create, start, stop, verify, status, and resume dispatch.
Listing reports ecosystem, definition, deterministic app name, support tier, prerequisites, supported actions, and adapter-declared local state.
Registry data is never evaluated; adapters resolve to unique, protocol-compatible, repository-contained, non-symlink regular files beneath a fixed root.

Invalid IDs, actions, duplicate adapters, controls, traversal, arbitrary adapter paths, and unsupported actions fail before mutation; -- separates top-level from adapter arguments while argv and exit codes propagate exactly.
Use adapter completion markers rather than generated-app definition data, and preserve native ecosystem commands as the rollback path.

approachReasons.tdd: The protocol, sorting, validation, argv boundaries, and exit propagation require fixture-first regression coverage.
approachReasons.dsa: Registry representation and deterministic ordering are core observable behavior.
approachReasons.security: The dispatcher crosses a command-execution trust boundary and must reject hostile registry data and paths.
approachReasons.migration: The new orchestrator must remain additive and preserve all native ecosystem entry points.
approachReasons.operations: State, prerequisites, action support, and failure propagation are operator-facing lifecycle behavior.

tasks.title: JavaScript compatibility adapter
acceptance: Expose every existing JavaScript framework/profile through adapter protocol v1 without changing profile definitions.
Map list, create, start, stop, status, and verify to existing scripts with deterministic names, skip/retry behavior, logs, and exit codes.
Representative direct and adapted plans and argv remain behavior-equivalent, including app-prefix and passthrough support.
The adapter does not parse or source JavaScript profile contents.

approachReasons.tdd: Direct-versus-adapter characterization protects existing JavaScript behavior.
approachReasons.migration: This is a compatibility adapter over established bootstrap and matrix commands.

tasks.title: WordPress existing-profile adapter
acceptance: List and individually provision existing bare, clean, custom, and loaded WordPress profiles through adapter protocol v1 without changing profiles or native bootstrap behavior.
List is mutation-free and create delegates exactly one selected profile with deterministic naming and state/verify behavior.
Reject restore and credential-bearing options at the showcase boundary; keep them available only through native bootstrap.
Never source or evaluate registry/profile text, and never adopt or alter existing apps/showcase-wp.

approachReasons.tdd: List, dispatch, unsupported restore, and dry-run behavior need exact fixtures.
approachReasons.security: Credential-bearing and restore options must not cross the showcase boundary.
approachReasons.migration: Existing WordPress profiles and bootstrap behavior must remain canonical and unchanged.

tasks.title: Laravel profile parser and legacy model
acceptance: Characterize bare, standard, and loaded, then add data-only starter, repeatable capability, support-tier, compatibility-probe, service, and health metadata.
Use indexed arrays for declaration order and maps for membership/conflicts; exact repeatables coalesce at first occurrence.
Reject duplicate singletons, controls, arbitrary commands, traversal, unknown metadata IDs, unknown capabilities, conflicts, cycles, implicit inheritance, and unavailable handlers before mutation.
Preserve existing profile files, names, package/database/migrate/seed/force/no-hosts plans, and CLI output; legacy plans remain byte-stable except approved additive metadata.
New metadata resolves to deterministic secret-safe plans while unknown handlers fail preflight.

approachReasons.tdd: Legacy characterization must precede parser/model changes and hostile-input fixtures.
approachReasons.dsa: Ordered de-duplication and conflict lookup depend on the selected array/map representation.
approachReasons.security: Profile data must remain non-executable and reject controls, traversal, arbitrary commands, and secret leakage.
approachReasons.migration: Canonical legacy profiles and exact existing behavior must survive the internal model transition.

tasks.title: Official Laravel starter engine
acceptance: Implement fixed non-interactive handlers for current-major none, livewire, react, vue, and svelte starters.
Run frontend dependency/build steps only when selected and record resolved Laravel, starter, and frontend versions in local evidence.
Probe compatibility before later mutation where feasible, expose trusted-upstream execution in plans, and provide diagnostic no-scripts behavior where feasible.
Every starter has an exact redacted dry-run plan and valid completion markers; timeout or failure leaves preserved actionable logs and unambiguous quarantine/recovery state.
Legacy starter-none behavior remains equivalent.

Research and validate current installer flags and constraints during implementation; after offline fixtures, perform one explicitly opt-in, uniquely named, bounded starter-none/minimal smoke with prerequisites, preserved logs, and cleanup, or report the unavailable prerequisite without claiming success.

approachReasons.tdd: Fake-installer fixtures must cover every starter, incompatibility, timeout, scripts mode, build selection, and failure stage.
approachReasons.security: Only fixed handlers and argv arrays may execute trusted upstream installers, with secrets excluded from output.
approachReasons.migration: The established no-starter Laravel path must remain behavior-equivalent.
approachReasons.operations: Timeouts, logs, completion markers, quarantine, and recovery define safe scaffold lifecycle behavior.

tasks.title: Reviewed Laravel capability handlers
acceptance: Implement fixed plan/install/configure/verify handlers for sanctum, horizon, reverb, telescope, pulse, pennant, scout-meilisearch, filament, and pest.
A code-owned registry maps fixed IDs to functions, conflicts, service/health requirements, compatibility checks, deterministic order, and recovery behavior.
Resolve handlers, conflicts, services, and health before mutation; exact duplicates coalesce and incompatible or unavailable requirements fail closed.

Use argv arrays, validated constraints, stdin/files for secrets, bounded timeouts, local version evidence, and explicit post-install checks; reject credential-bearing Git/HTTPS URLs and definition-supplied commands.
Start only selected services, and keep synthetic secrets out of argv, output, logs, recovery, and definitions.

approachReasons.tdd: Table-driven fixtures and fake Composer/Artisan execution are required for each handler and failure mode.
approachReasons.dsa: Stable ordered de-duplication, conflict detection, and service aggregation rely on explicit registry structures.
approachReasons.security: Package execution, constraints, service inputs, and secrets cross multiple trust boundaries.
approachReasons.migration: Capabilities are additive and legacy profile behavior must remain usable.
approachReasons.operations: Service health, timeouts, postconditions, evidence, and recovery are part of every handler.

tasks.title: Curated Laravel profile catalog
acceptance: Add explicit non-inheriting minimal, web, api, livewire, react, vue, svelte, queues, realtime, admin, search, observability, and testing profiles.

Exact combinations: minimal = SQLite + starter none; web = MariaDB + Mailpit + starter none; api = MariaDB + Sanctum; livewire/react/vue/svelte = matching official starter + MariaDB + Mailpit; queues = MariaDB + Redis + Mailpit + Horizon; realtime = MariaDB + Redis + Reverb; admin = MariaDB + Mailpit + Filament; search = MariaDB + Meilisearch + Scout; observability = MariaDB + Redis + Telescope + Pulse; testing = SQLite + Pest + deterministic test execution.

After exact offline plan/support/compatibility fixtures for every profile, opt-in smokes specifically cover minimal, api, react, queues, and observability with unique names, bounded execution, prerequisites, preserved failure logs, HTTPS/Artisan/service postconditions, and cleanup; unavailable prerequisites are explicit gaps, not passes.
Each profile declares support tier, compatibility probe, required services/health probes, and exact description.
Retain canonical bare, standard, and loaded files/names; list all profiles lexically with exact secret-safe conflict-free plans.
Do not add external-account, billing/social, tenancy, Octane, inheritance, matrix, or recipe behavior, and leave apps/showcase-laravel untouched.

approachReasons.tdd: Every legacy and new profile needs an exact offline plan/support/compatibility table before representative smokes.
approachReasons.security: Profile composition must remain data-only and secret-safe across packages and services.
approachReasons.migration: Legacy canonical profile names and behavior must remain intact while the catalog grows additively.
approachReasons.operations: Profiles declare concrete prerequisites, services, health checks, failure logs, and cleanup.

tasks.title: Laravel scaffold matrix
acceptance: Add lexical list, create, create-all, start, stop, status, and verify commands over apps/showcase-laravel-<profile> targets.
Support a DNS-safe prefix override and require artisan plus composer.json completion markers.

Bulk creation is sequential and resumable with bounded retry/timeouts only for fresh acquisition, unique run IDs, prerequisite checks, per-profile logs, independent continuation, and nonzero failure summary.

Skip complete matrix targets; refuse incomplete/pre-existing matrix targets without explicit recovery/replacement and back up before authorized replacement. Never automatically adopt, rename, overwrite, or delete unmanaged apps/showcase-laravel. Reject symlink writes, target escape, and dangerous cleanup paths; keep generated apps ignored and preserve direct bootstrap semantics.

Run the full Laravel suites and an opt-in one-profile create/status/verify/stop smoke with prerequisites and cleanup. Do not add a top-level adapter, concurrency, default start-all, pruning, recipes, or profile internals in this task.

approachReasons.tdd: Matrix state, skip, unmanaged targets, retry, timeout, continuation, and summaries require offline failure-injection fixtures.
approachReasons.migration: Native bootstrap behavior and unmanaged applications must remain untouched.
approachReasons.operations: Bulk lifecycle, prerequisite checks, run IDs, logs, recovery, and cleanup are the task's primary behavior.

tasks.title: Laravel showcase adapter
acceptance: Expose native Laravel matrix list, create, start, stop, status, and verify through adapter protocol v1.
Report exact action support, state, prerequisites, support tier, and exit propagation.
Declare resume unsupported for single matrix entries rather than emulating it; recipe resume remains recipe-owned.
Direct and adapted argv, output, and exit behavior remain equivalent, with no matrix/profile/bootstrap changes.

approachReasons.tdd: Protocol, action, argv, exit, and list-state parity require exact fixtures.
approachReasons.migration: The adapter must preserve native Laravel matrix and bootstrap behavior without emulation.

tasks.title: Recoverable multi-app recipe engine
acceptance: Coordinate tracked data-only recipes containing app nodes, dependency edges, and named non-secret configuration links.
Validate unique IDs, acyclic graph, adapters/profiles/actions, paths, outputs, target collisions, and all inputs before mutation.
Execute Kahn topological order with lexical node-ID tie-breaking and no arbitrary commands, templates, concurrency, or secret recipe values.

Persist versioned secret-free line records with whitespace-free ID/status/path fields for pre-existing, creating, created, failed, and pending nodes, bound to recipe hash and prefix; write a sibling temporary file, fsync where available, then atomically rename.

Failures preserve independent and pre-existing nodes, reject symlink writes, target escape, and dangerous cleanup paths, move partial adapter targets to .devarch-failed quarantine, block dependents, and leave actionable secret-free state.
Status/resume validate schema, recipe hash, prefix, paths, and definition identity; stale or corrupt records fail closed and generated trees are never auto-deleted.

approachReasons.tdd: Graph, parser, atomic transition, interruption, stale-state, collision, and resume behavior need failure-injection tests.
approachReasons.dsa: DAG representation and lexical Kahn traversal determine correctness and deterministic execution.
approachReasons.security: Recipe parsing, adapter dispatch, paths, outputs, and recovery records cross command and data trust boundaries.
approachReasons.migration: Pre-existing applications must be preserved and never adopted or deleted.
approachReasons.operations: Atomic durable state, interruption recovery, status, resume, quarantine, and manual cleanup are central.

tasks.title: Laravel API plus TanStack Start recipe
acceptance: Ship separately routable showcase-laravel-tanstack-api and showcase-laravel-tanstack-web apps as one recipe using Laravel API/Sanctum and TanStack Start/Router/Query.
Add a current TanStack Start JavaScript definition with support tier, compatibility probe, and resolved-version evidence.
Configure frontend API URL and Laravel CORS/Sanctum stateful domains only through allowlisted adapter-owned non-secret outputs.
Provide start, stop, status, resume, and verify; prove HTTPS, API health/JSON, allowed local CORS origin, and recovery after second-node failure.
Apps remain ignored, independently routable and recoverable; do not promise monorepo, deployment topology, external identity, generic templates, or SSR auth beyond the documented flow.

approachReasons.tdd: Definition, edge, configuration, hostile output, scaffold, failure, atomic recovery, and resume need offline fixtures before real smoke.
approachReasons.security: CORS, Sanctum domains, adapter-owned outputs, and hostile configuration values require explicit trust boundaries.
approachReasons.migration: The JavaScript definition is additive and generated apps must remain separable and recoverable.
approachReasons.operations: Two-app start/stop/status/resume, logs, health checks, failure preservation, and cleanup are required.

tasks.title: Integrated golden paths and documentation
acceptance: Document and verify top-level discovery, JavaScript compatibility, Laravel profiles/matrix, WordPress adaptation, and the Laravel-TanStack recipe.

Default verification covers focused and adjacent offline suites, characterization, shell syntax, deterministic snapshots, WordPress dry-run, secret canaries, and failure/recovery exercises using temporary repository roots, fake executables, deterministic clock/hash seams, and no real apps, hosts files, external credentials, or network.

Opt-in golden paths are uniquely named, prerequisite-checked, bounded, preserve failure logs, and include cleanup for Laravel minimal, api, react, queues, and observability, the existing JavaScript runtime, and the two-app recipe.

Documentation distinguishes tracked reproducible definitions from ignored disposable generated apps, unmanaged apps, and matrix apps; explains support tiers, actions, prerequisites, non-sandboxed trusted-upstream execution, recovery, and cleanup; and catalogs billing, WorkOS/social, multi-tenancy, and Octane only as non-executable future candidates.
Every documented command is exercised by tests or a durable runtime report, and the acceptance-to-evidence report records any genuine blocking gap.
No new features, profile expansion, premature performance optimization, concurrent all-profile startup, external SaaS validation, or unrelated worktree mutation.

approachReasons.tdd: The final contract must execute all focused, adjacent, characterization, static, and golden-path checks against documented behavior.
approachReasons.security: Integrated verification must scan argv, logs, definitions, and recovery state for secret canaries.
approachReasons.migration: Compatibility suites must prove existing native commands and unmanaged applications remain intact.
approachReasons.operations: Golden paths require bounded prerequisites, timeouts, logs, health evidence, recovery, and cleanup documentation.
